readings: Looking only at films whose `rental_duration` is more than 5 days, group them by `rating`. For each rating, show the rating, the average per film of `rental_rate` divided by `rental_duration` (ignoring missing values), the number of films, and that average divided by an overall benchmark. The benchmark is the plain unweighted mean of the per-rating averages across all ratings, ignoring any missing ones. If the benchmark itself is missing, return no rows. Leave all values unrounded.
queries:
WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(CAST(rental_rate AS REAL) / rental_duration) AS average_rate_per_day,
    COUNT(*) AS film_count
  FROM film
  WHERE rental_duration > 5
  GROUP BY rating
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_rate_per_day) AS value
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT
  r.rating,
  r.average_rate_per_day,
  r.film_count,
  r.average_rate_per_day / b.value AS average_to_benchmark
FROM rating_averages AS r
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE b.value IS NOT NULL
